name: dependency-preloaded-after-a-launcher
description: A runtime flag that preloads a module counts in a command whose program is node behind a launcher: env with --, -u and an -S value, cross-env with an assignment, and npx with --yes, -p and a -c value, a quoted operator or a glob inside it included. A launcher option that prints and exits, as npx --version does, leaves the command with no program, so the dependency only that command preloads is reported.
pending: roots.13: a preload flag read behind a launcher's options or inside the command value a launcher holds, and a launcher option that prints and exits, land with the static reader of script commands.
